description: Wire the UI: on the employee My Attendance page add a single 'Raise a request' entry point opening a dialog that lets the user pick one of the three request kinds (Work from home / Explain an absence / Forgot to log in) and submit it to the admin, plus a history list with cancel; on the admin Approvals screen add a pending attendance-requests card with approve/reject + note; and extend the Approvals tab pending-count badge to include these. All copy says 'admin', never 'HR'. Reuse the existing design-system components and the LeaveCard / WFH-card patterns exactly.
steps: In src/routes/_authenticated/attendance.tsx add a new card component (e.g. AttendanceRequestsCard), rendered inside MonthSection next to LeaveCard, modeled closely on LeaveCard. Header: title with a lucide icon (e.g. ClipboardCheck or FileWarning) and a Button 'Raise a request' opening a Dialog. The Dialog lets the employee choose the request type via a Select (or segmented buttons) from ATTENDANCE_REQUEST_TYPES with friendly labels: 'Work from home', 'Explain an absence', 'I forgot to log in'. Fields shown adapt to the type: all types show a work date (Input type=date) and a reason (Textarea); work_from_home optionally shows a 'to' date for a range; 'I forgot to log in' (missed_login_regularization) shows requested login and logout time inputs (Input type=time). Submit via hrRequest({ action: 'apply_attendance_request', type, work_date, to_date?, reason, requested_login?, requested_logout? }) using the hrRequest wrapper, with a success toast 'Request sent to the admin', closing the dialog and invalidating the history query. Mirror LeaveCard's useMutation/onSuccess/onError + getErrorMessage pattern.

Add a history list in that card like LeaveCard's: fetch via a new useQuery over fetchAttendanceRequests({ employeeId }) (or an inline hrmsDb query mirroring my-leave-history), showing date/range, a type badge, status badge (reuse a status->class map like LEAVE_STATUS_CLASS), the reason, admin note when present, and a Cancel button for pending rows calling hrRequest({ action: 'cancel_attendance_request', id }). Prefill the work date with the currently viewed day where sensible (optional).

Optionally (nice-to-have, keep additive and low-risk) surface a quick entry from an ABSENT or ACTION-NEEDED day: e.g. in the month view or the actionNeeded banner, a small link that opens the same dialog pre-set to 'Explain an absence' / 'I forgot to log in' for that date. Only do this if it does not complicate the existing MonthCalendar/attendance-month components; otherwise the toolbar button is sufficient. Do not change the punch/login flow.

In src/routes/_authenticated/hrms/approvals.tsx add a new Card 'Attendance requests (N)' above or beside the WFH/Leave cards, mirroring their structure. Query pending attendance_requests via hrmsDb().from('attendance_requests').eq('status','pending').order('work_date'). For each row show employee name (useEmployeeMap), the type label, the date/range, requested login/logout times for missed-login, the reason, and the shared actions() row (note Input + Approve/Reject). Wire Approve/Reject through the existing decide useMutation by extending it to support a new kind 'attendance_request' -> hrRequest({ action: 'decide_attendance_request', id, approve, note }). Add these decided items into the 'Decided in the last 30 days' recent list too (optional but consistent), labeled by type.
Extend the refresh() invalidation lists on both pages to include the new query keys (e.g. 'my-attendance-requests', 'hrms-attendance-requests-pending', and 'hrms-approval-counts').

In src/routes/_authenticated/hrms.tsx extend the pending-count query to also count pending attendance_requests (add a third head/count query to the Promise.all and sum it), so the Approvals tab badge includes them.

Add any new query keys consistently; keep all new copy referring to 'admin'. Run prettier on any new/edited files per repo policy (new files must be prettier-clean; touched files must gain no new eslint errors).

Run `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`, `bun run test`, and `bun run build` (build will regenerate src/routeTree.gen.ts only if a route file was added — none should be, since these are edits to existing routes; commit it if it changes).
acceptance_criteria: My Attendance shows a 'Raise a request' entry opening a dialog that supports all three types (work_from_home, absence_clarification, missed_login_regularization) with type-appropriate fields, submitting via apply_attendance_request, and a history list with a working Cancel for pending rows.
Admin Approvals shows a pending attendance-requests card with per-type details and working Approve/Reject (+ optional note) via decide_attendance_request, and the employee is notified on decision.
The /hrms Approvals tab badge count includes pending attendance_requests.
All user-facing copy says 'admin', never 'HR'. New files are prettier-clean; touched files gain no new eslint errors.
`./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`, `bun run test`, and `bun run build` all exit 0.
verification: `bun run build` succeeds; if routeTree.gen.ts changed it is committed.

Manually read the two route files to confirm the dialog submits the correct action/body per type and the admin card calls decide_attendance_request, reusing existing UI components (Dialog/Select/Textarea/Input/Button/Badge/Card) and the established card/button styling.
